# Zichen Chen

> Zichen Chen is a researcher at Stanford HAI and the Digital Economy Lab, mentored by Prof. Alex 'Sandy' Pentland. She is a final-year PhD candidate in Computer Science at UC Santa Barbara, advised by Prof. Misha Sra. Her research focuses on agentic AI, trust and interpretability, data-centric AI, and human-AI co-reasoning. She is the founder of BakeAI.

## Links

- [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=X4goIzYAAAAJ): Full publication list and citation metrics
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chenzichen): Professional profile

- [BakeAI](https://bakeai.inc/): AI startup founded by Zichen Chen

## Current Projects

- [AutoLab](https://autolab.moe/): An open benchmark arena for evaluating AI agents on real-world performance engineering tasks. [GitHub](https://github.com/autolabhq/autolab)
- [VAB - Visual Aesthetic Benchmark](https://vab.bakelab.ai/): A large-scale evaluation of frontier AI models on artist-curated artworks. [GitHub](https://github.com/BakeLab/Visual-Aesthetic-Benchmark)

## Selected Publications

- [CoDA: Agentic Systems for Collaborative Data Visualization](https://coda-agent.github.io/CoDA/): Zichen Chen, Jiefeng Chen, Sercan O. Arik, Misha Sra, Tomas Pfister, Jinsung Yoon. ICLR 2026.
- [XplainLLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.01481): A Knowledge-Augmented Dataset for Reliable Grounded Explanations in LLMs. EMNLP 2024.
- [State-Chrono](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.07706): A Benchmark for Temporal State Understanding in LLMs. NeurIPS 2024.
- [FedOBD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.05174): Opportunistic Block Dropout for Efficiently Training Large-scale Neural Networks through Federated Learning. IJCAI 2023. AAAI Innovation Award.
